fade_in_hero.css: @keyframes fade_in_hero { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .hero-content { animation: fade_in_hero 0.8s ease-out forwards; }

hover_card_lift.css: .feature-card, .pricing-card { transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .feature-card:hover, .pricing-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #4F6BFF; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(79,107,255,0.15); }

gradient_border_glow.css: @keyframes gradient_border_glow { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(79,107,255,0.3); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(167,139,250,0.5); } } .glow-border { animation: gradient_border_glow 3s ease-in-out infinite; border: 1px solid transparent; background-image: linear-gradient(#171923,#171923), linear-gradient(135deg,#4F6BFF,#A78BFA); background-origin: border-box; background-clip: padding-box, border-box; }

counter_animation_stats.css: @keyframes counter_animation_stats { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } } .stat-number { animation: counter_animation_stats 1s ease-out forwards; display: inline-block; }

home.layout: Centered dark hero with gradient text headline and dual CTAs, followed by logo strip, 3-column feature grid, code snippet demo block, testimonial carousel, and pricing preview.

features.layout: Stacked feature category sections alternating left/right with illustrations, comparison table, video embed, and 6-column integration logos grid.

pricing.layout: Centered monthly/annual toggle above three side-by-side pricing tier cards with feature checklists, followed by enterprise CTA banner and FAQ accordion.

docs.layout: Two-column layout with left sidebar navigation and main content area containing quick start, tabbed SDK install snippets, and linked guide cards.

blog.layout: Category filter bar above two-column grid of article cards with author avatars, separate changelog timeline section, and email subscribe form.
